description: This file implements a TCP receiver for the Zephyr network stack, handling socket creation, binding, listening, accepting connections, receiving data, and session management for zperf testing.

methods.name: tcp_received
methods.description: Handles incoming TCP data, updates session state, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: tcp_receiver_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up socket services and resets session state.

methods.name: tcp_recv_data
methods.description: Receives data from socket, manages connection acceptance, and processes received data.

methods.name: tcp_svc_handler
methods.description: Handles socket service events and triggers data reception.

methods.name: tcp_bind_listen_connection
methods.description: Binds socket to address and starts listening.

methods.name: zperf_tcp_receiver_init
methods.description: Initializes TCP receiver sockets and binds to configured addresses.

methods.name: zperf_tcp_download
methods.description: Starts TCP download session with specified parameters and callback.
